notes.title: WELCOME TO NIVALIS - MAY 2025 COMMUNITY BLOG
notes.content:
May has, as always, been a month full of work, where we focused on improving the game and implementing major adjustments and refinements. We also had the chance to spend time together as a team, which is always a valuable opportunity to share ideas and continue on our path to reach our goal: to let you explore Nivalis soon, and in the best form possible. 

In the meantime, we’re also gathering your most frequently asked questions and working on updating the [b]FAQ [/b]section on the forum, so we can provide you with an up-to-date version as soon as possible. For this devlog, however, we’d like to dust off the [b]Character Spotlight[/b], to reintroduce you to some of the many faces you’ll encounter on your journey through the lively city we’re building. 
  
[h2]CHARACTER SPOTLIGHT - SALT PETE [/h2]

If you happen to find yourself strolling near the docks, it won’t be hard to spot a tall, blocky robot with a straw hat and two large glass eyes ready to give you a careful once-over. That’s Salt Pete, who runs a makeshift ferry -  little more than some riveted sheet metal - which he claims is the safest, cheapest way to cross the bay. Will you trust this big hunk of metal? 

[i] “I make this crossing safely 95% of the time, all of the time!” [/i]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40604727/72412bada348f4ebcfccdaae7a3fa802826dfd9d.png[/img]
 
Pete certainly has a cheerful attitude, but he also has a mean streak that he doesn’t bother to hide. He’s often seen bickering with the other robots at the harbor - whom he doesn’t seem to like very much - and he won’t hesitate to drag you into the drama. He loves listening to the stories of his passengers, but you’ll rarely hear him talk about his own past in his wheezy, robotic voice. According to him, there are plenty of others around who can “fill your ears with tall stories”. 

[i]“So anyway, that old dustbin Caleb called me a bad sailor. Me! He wouldn’t know a sailboat if he woke up and was suddenly a sailboat.” [/i]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40604727/1fec5d9e5c7e46efa1295dd352620c120e49262a.png[/img]

As always, we thank you for your support and patience. The months ahead are the most challenging yet, and our focus right now is entirely on polishing and fine-tuning, without pause. Your affection doesn’t go unnoticed - it’s instrumental for the whole team.

notes.title: WELCOME TO NIVALIS – MARCH 2025 COMMUNITY BLOG
notes.content:
Another intense month of work has passed, and Nivalis continues to take shape under our hands, growing alongside us as a team. Among the many daily challenges it presents, we've recently been focusing on implementing and optimizing certain features, improving the save system, and welcoming and guiding new members into our team. 

We enjoyed reading your comments under our previous blog post, and your creativity has certainly been an inspiration! Of course, we can’t promise that all of your ideas will make it into the game, but for some of them, you’ll definitely see our personal touch woven into the Nivalis experience. 
 
This month, we want to shine a spotlight on one of the features you’ve mentioned – [b]farming [/b]- which will be present in the game in a particular form. 
  
[h3]WELCOME TO THE GREENHOUSES 🌾[/h3]

In a city like Nivalis, space for urban greenery is limited. While many citizens love to decorate their personal spaces with some plants, farming requires something more advanced. 

For this reason, scattered across various areas of the map, you’ll find multiple [b]greenhouses[/b]. These high-tech structures will allow you to grow crops even in an industrial environment and will be highly customizable to suit your needs… and farming skills. 
 
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40604727/af4b9e51a32e45f92c14b10a6003684cb14b270c.png[/img]
  
Inside the greenhouses, you’ll be free to use the available space as you see fit, decorating and equipping it with specialized machinery purchased from different vendors around the city, each catering to a specific purpose. You’ll be able to grow [b]mushrooms[/b], [b]grains[/b], [b]vegetables [/b]- if you acquire the necessary seeds - and even [b]print meat[/b] and automate certain processes, such as irrigation. 

Through a farming console, you’ll be able to configure the conditions of your personal farm for optimal cultivation and the best possible yield. These control consoles will allow you to adjust various parameters such as [b]temperature[/b], [b]humidity[/b], and [b]light [/b]- factors that directly influence the growth speed of your crops. 
  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40604727/cac3702d49ce2dbec5e2886214f81a785d93b0fd.png[/img]
 
Every citizen - with enough money - [b]can rent and manage more than one greenhouse[/b]. Over time, with the right skills, you’ll be able to acquire more seeds and [b]unlock advanced modules[/b] to expand your farming empire! 

What you do with your harvest is entirely up to you: you can sell it for profit or use it to supply ingredients for your restaurants. Given that running a restaurant will become quite the challenge at a certain point, using your crops this way might not be a bad idea - it could definitively help you optimize your profits. 
  
There’s more waiting for you in the streets of Nivalis, and we know you can’t wait to dive into the secrets of this city, but we ask for just a little more patience. This is a slow cook, but we hope you’ll enjoy the journey.

notes.title: WELCOME TO NIVALIS - DECEMBER 2024 COMMUNITY BLOG
notes.content:
[h3][b]WELCOME TO NIVALIS - DECEMBER 2024 COMMUNITY BLOG[/b][/h3]

Time really flies, and we've reached the last community blog of 2024. It’s been a year full of hard work, challenges, and tough decisions, but thanks to your incredible support, we’re ready to dive into 2025 with enthusiasm and open the doors to the world of Nivalis, a place we’ve come to think of as our home. 
 
So, let’s take this opportunity to do a quick [b]recap[/b] of what we’ve shared with you over the past year! 

[h3][b]NIVALIS IN 2024 [/b][/h3]

We kicked off the year by showcasing a glimpse of the game during the [b]Taipei Game Show[/b], an incredibly valuable experience that gave us plenty to think about and helped us set several new goals. 

Throughout 2024, as a fully remote studio, we organized several meetings that we like to call workshops, where we explored numerous ideas, left behind previous concepts, and worked on new ones. Nivalis is a complex mix of features that is hard to tame, but we're getting there! 
 
For all the virtual photographers out there, we also gave you a glimpse of the [b]photo mode[/b] for Nivalis. Designed to give you the feel of using a realistic camera, we introduced you to some of its features: the ability to change focus distance, aperture, focal length, field of view, and the chance to experiment with a wide range of creative filters and image modification settings. We’re confident you’ll have a lot of fun capturing some of the city’s atmospheric views scattered here and there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40604727/06a925c1238186bf5325cb6c91717c038efeffc6.jpg[/img]

We answered many of your questions, showcased some of the local dishes you’ll be able to serve at your tables, and once again [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1488490/view/4149583271149243918?l=english]put the spotlight on our composer Harry Critchley[/url], who last year shared a detailed look at his work with you. The soundtrack of Nivalis is a core part of the game, one of the pillars of the immersive experience we aim to deliver. 

As part of the 2024 Games Baked in Germany event, we unveiled a [b]new trailer[/b], packed with never-before-seen locations and story hints through Ava, one of the main characters you’ll meet in the game. Our city truly took on a life of its own, growing and evolving in ways that sometimes even surprised us. 

[previewyoutube=VYykZ9RBo3w;full][/previewyoutube]

Speaking of characters, we’ve begun introducing you to some of the protagonists of the many stories that Nivalis will bring to life. We introduced [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1488490/view/4674264677141576187?l=english]Thaddeus Carmunis[/url], a 92-year-old business owner on the brink of retirement, who has some valuable advice to share, and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1488490/view/4467100996153114863?l=english]Banor[/url], a man with an unusual sense of humor who might just turn out to be a key ally in the chaotic work life of Nivalis.

[h3][b]A MESSAGE FROM US[/b][/h3] 

As you can probably imagine by now, it’s been a truly intense year, with so much happening behind the scenes. We’ve experimented with many ideas, and we continue to do so to breathe more life into Nivalis. As the city grows and evolves, so do we as a team, facing life’s normal challenges, watching families expand, and sharing in your incredible enthusiasm, the fuel that drives our work. 

We can’t wait to see you wandering the streets and alleys we’re meticulously crafting, voxel by voxel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40604727/5a1883c34305991c3cbefab26569ab9afec67d52.jpg[/img]

notes.title: WELCOME TO NIVALIS - NOVEMBER 2024 COMMUNITY BLOG
notes.content:
[h3][b]WELCOME TO NIVALIS - NOVEMBER 2024 COMMUNITY BLOG[/b][/h3]

The end of the year is almost upon us! For every month that passes, we’re a month closer to launch. 2025 really is just around the corner and we’re incredibly excited with what’s to come. 

As we look back on 2024, we’re so thankful for all the support you’ve shown us. Every message of encouragement and excitement fuels us to keep pushing and deliver a game that we’re all proud of. 

Back to this month’s blog, we’re going to address some of the FAQs we’ve seen and treat you all to some new screenshots from in-game. Enjoy!

[h3][b]COMMUNITY QUESTIONS[/b][/h3]

[b]Is there any sort of procedural generation in the game? If so, what will it be? Characters? Apartments? Something else?[/b]

Each level has been carefully crafted by our team of developers at ION LANDS. As a result, Nivalis does not require any procedurally generated assets. We can’t wait for you to explore our world. A lot of love has gone into it!

Internally, we have designed some level design tools with procedural generation in mind, for example tools that help coming up with building variations or world decoration. They basically help with a lot of repetitive tasks, but are never just going into the game without a designer’s decision.

[b]Will Nivalis be playable in both 1st and 3rd person?[/b]

Nivalis exclusively features an immersive first-person gameplay, letting players fully explore its vibrant cyberpunk world and interact with its environment for an engaging experience. It’s an atmospheric experience just the same as a game.

[b]Will Nivalis be compatible on Steam Deck?[/b]

Our priority is delivering an enjoyable and stable experience on PC. If we ever consider Steam Deck verification, we’ll communicate this across our official channels. 

[b]Is there an official Nivalis Bluesky account? [/b]

Yes, there is! Follow us here: https://bsky.app/profile/playnivalis.bsky.social 

[b]Will Nivalis ever launch on Mac?[/b]

Right now, we’re working towards launching Nivalis on PC (Steam and Epic Games). If we consider any additional platforms in the future, we will let you know. 

[b]Will there be weather effects in Nivalis?[/b]

Yes! You can expect a wide range of weather in the world of Nivalis, including snow, rain, fog, thunderstorms and sunshine! 

[h3][b]GOT A QUESTION ON NIVALIS? LET US KNOW![/b][/h3]

Remember that as part of these monthly blogs, we want to address any community questions you might have. Is there anything you want to ask the team? Throw us your questions here on Steam.

[h3][b]ALL-NEW SCREENSHOTS[/b][/h3]

Today we’re treating you to a selection of all-new screenshots from Nivalis. The world of Nivalis is varied and inviting and we can’t wait for you to explore it.

notes.title: WELCOME TO NIVALIS - OCTOBER 2024 COMMUNITY BLOG
notes.content:
[h3][b]WELCOME TO NIVALIS - OCTOBER 2024 COMMUNITY BLOG[/b][/h3]

We’re continuing our spotlight series this month with another character introduction. Back in September, we gave you an insight into Thaddeus Carminus. With Thaddeus’ retirement looming, he leaves you his noodle bar in Meridian Market, located in the heart of Nivalis. It’s there you’ll meet your new employee, Banor. 

[h3][b]CHARACTER SPOTLIGHT - BANOR[/b][/h3]

An old man with a distinctive white beard and round spectacles, you’ll come face to face with Banor for the very first time when you take on the daunting task of running your first restaurant. 

[i]"I cleaned the oven properly. Used the degreaser. The shelves were oilier than the rags in my basement."[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40604727/d0241faf619b7bca8d8432bf37227d94739ce5fa.jpg[/img]

This 64 year old ex-restaurant owner isn’t getting any younger and despite being cheery and hard working, his aches and pains are beginning to get in the way. Despite trying to hide his discomfort,. Banor remains a strong character, well adjusted and helpful. 

This is someone who, of course, also enjoys great food. Banor can be charming, but often over-shares or makes bad jokes. Occasionally he’ll come out with something wise though. So keep your eyes and ears open and listen to what he has to say. Banor speaks with authority through his warm, cheery old voice. 

[i]"I'll see you first thing tomorrow boss. I won't be late. I've got nowhere else to be!"
[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40604727/7011ec5701efd361678bea5234f66dddc16612e8.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]VIRTUAL PHOTOGRAPHERS, MAKE YOURSELF KNOWN! [/b][/h3]

Are you a passionate virtual photographer? If so, we want to hear from you. Earlier this year, we gave you all an insight into Nivalis’ photo mode, a feature we’re super excited about here at ION LANDS and 505 Games. Missed that update? Check it out here:

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1488490/view/4138316665189619105 
With that in mind, we would love to hear from anyone in our community who enjoys virtual photography and has a keen interest in Nivalis. Let us know in the comments below. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40604727/05d12164aad89ca68277885b12276c2224b56a26.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]GOT A QUESTION ON NIVALIS? LET US KNOW![/b][/h3]

Remember that as part of these monthly blogs, we want to address any community questions you might have. Is there anything you want to ask the team? Throw your questions in the comments below!

notes.title: WELCOME TO NIVALIS - SEPTEMBER 2024 COMMUNITY BLOG
notes.content:
[h3][b]WELCOME TO NIVALIS - SEPTEMBER 2024 COMMUNITY BLOG[/b][/h3]

A little later than planned, but welcome back to another Nivalis community blog! As part of our future posts, we’ll be putting the spotlight on a number of individuals you’ll come across on your adventure throughout Nivalis. Today, we’re starting with a character that you’ll come across almost the moment you leave your apartment. 

[h3][b]CHARACTER SPOTLIGHT - THADDEUS CARMUNIS[/b][/h3]

[i]"I lived my whole life behind that hot plate. It was my whole world. Now it's time for me to find another one."[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40604727/f153e8cbdb59df11778c4249493c10d942e401ca.png[/img]
Meet Thaddeus Carmunis. A 92 year old business owner on the brink of retirement. You’ll meet Thaddeus very early on in your journey. A gruff but friendly character, Thaddeus is very tired of life in Nivalis. Early on he will warn you that there are two ways to go in life: build a community, so others are a little less miserable, or climb on top of everyone’s shoulders to rise to the top. 

Old and grizzled with a long grey beard, the demands of his long career show. He’s worked his whole life for very little reward. An impatient character, Thaddeus is also friendly and thoughtful. He won’t judge you, so whether you’re cunning or kind in your decision making, he’ll respect you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40604727/2ad81c03c13d4a374fa1c3405abcb001a4b00d05.png[/img]
[i]"Be cunning or be kind. That's all I can say to you. If you're kind, make sure you don't let them walk all over you. And if you're cunning, don't let them catch you out. Cunning, kind, selfish, saintly - whatever type of person you want to be, be smart. Be smart and you'll make it."[/i]

Stay tuned for more Nivalis character profiles! 

[h3][b]THE WORLD OF NIVALIS[/b][/h3]

Enjoy these all-new screenshots taken directly from Nivalis. Like what you see? Let us know. We can't wait to show and tell you more over the coming weeks and months.

notes.title: WELCOME TO NIVALIS - AUGUST 2024 COMMUNITY BLOG
notes.content:
[h3][b]WELCOME TO NIVALIS - AUGUST 2024 COMMUNITY BLOG[/b][/h3]

Welcome back to our monthly community blog. Today, we want to take this opportunity to address some of the feedback we received in response to our July Community Questions. We also have some all-new gameplay footage to show you and a series of shiny new screenshots. Let’s get started…

[h3][b]GAMESTAR [/b][/h3]

Last week, all-new Nivalis gameplay was shown to the world during GameStar’s FYNG showcase. Missed the stream? Don’t worry, you can check it out here: 

[url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/2230818001?t=08h19m23s]WATCH: NIVALIS FEATURED AT GAMESTAR'S FYNG SHOWCASE 2024[/url]

[h3][b]COMMUNITY QUESTIONS[/b][/h3]

Last month, we asked you all a series of community questions. We wanted to know what you’re most excited about, what has stood out the most for you, if there was anything you’d like to see from behind the scenes and what social media content you’d like us to focus on in the run up to launch. We had some fantastic responses, so thank you! 

A number of you expressed an interest in “making of” content. This is something we can certainly look into. We really want you to feel like you’re on this journey with us, and strongly believe that by giving you a glimpse into what goes on behind the scenes, this will help with that. If there’s anything you’d like to see in particular, please let us know. 

When asked what you’re most excited about, many of you said you were simply looking forward to exploring the world of Nivalis. And that’s understandable! We’ll continue to showcase what you can expect over the coming months through our monthly community blogs, videos and screenshots. As for social media content, gameplay was highlighted on a few occasions. It seems like many of you want to virtually explore this world. We’re open to this idea, so leave it with us and we’ll give you a series of guided tours when we’re ready. 

[h3][b]THE WORLD OF NIVALIS[/b][/h3]
Take a moment to enjoy these all-new screenshots, captured from Nivalis. Like what you see? Let us know your thoughts!

notes.title: WELCOME TO NIVALIS - JULY 2024 COMMUNITY BLOG
notes.content:
Hi everyone. We’re back with another relatively short but sweet community blog. Despite all the hard work going on behind the scenes, we don’t have a lot of new content to show you this month. But don’t worry! When the time is right, we’ll have plenty to show off. Today, we want to take this opportunity to address some of the questions we’ve come across recently and take this moment to ask YOU some questions. Ready? Let’s go. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40604727/5c82ba598bf55816bde6cd83dff24753ccfa03f1.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]RELEASE WINDOW UPDATE[/b][/h3]

If you’re new around here, last month we announced our release window and unveiled our all-new trailer. Take a moment to enjoy it here: 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VYykZ9RBo3w 

To those who have been on this journey with us for some time now, just know we appreciate you and your loyalty more than you know. It’ll be worth the wait!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40604727/d3c60a02c5400832b49ab8ca68957139525779e9.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]QUESTIONS FOR OUR COMMUNITY[/b][/h3]

As we continue to look through our forums for your questions, it got us thinking about you! With that in mind, we have a few questions that we’d love to hear your thoughts on.

[list]
[*] What are you most excited for when it comes to Nivalis?
[*] With what you know about Nivalis, what has stood out the most for you?
[*] Is there anything you'd like to see from behind the scenes? 
[*] What kind of social media content would you like to see from us in the run up to launch? 
[/list]
Leave us your responses in the comments below! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40604727/0cfa24a229df1a83753b3f2fa409a252aeedfe60.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]COMMUNITY QUESTIONS[/b][/h3]

[b]Can we expect any criminal activity in the game? I know that unlike Cloudpunk this game isn't playing up the, "it's PUNK!" in its marketing as much, but is this thing just cyber or is it also cyberpunk? It appears that you're some kind of up and coming business owner? Is it a front for smuggling, gang hideouts, or at least real estate disputes? Is that the angle they're going for? Or is it just a game where you sip cyber-coffee and eat cyber-fish?[/b]

You will not become a criminal kingpin in Nivalis. Our game focuses more around the immersive nature in this dystopian world. ION LANDS want to capture the atmosphere of how the life of a normal person feels in a Cyberpunk world. You have your day-to-day business, and your goal is to run all the businesses and own the nightlife of Nivalis. On the other side, there is a huge city to explore and of course there are many characters to meet and to learn more about their stories. BUT, there are some criminal activities going on in Nivalis and that’s the serial killer who is lurking through the streets.

[b]A question about a playable character. Is it possible to choose gender, appearance, etc in the Nivalis?[/b]

We are aware that customisation is a big topic, especially for slice-of-life simulations. We are discussing with the team what’s possible.

[b]Are there plans to release a demo before launch?[/b]

We know that our fans are eager to visit Nivalis before launch. But we need to make sure we are ready and that the timing is right. If there are any demo plans, you will be the first ones to find out about it. But it’s safe to say that there will be no demo in 2024.

notes.title: Nivalis - Official Summer 2024 Trailer and Release Date Update
notes.content:
As part of today's 2024 Games Baked in Germany event, we shared some exciting and important updates on Nivalis. Not only did we have an-all new trailer to showcase, but we have a release window!

Nivalis will be launching in Spring 2025! 

Our city has taken on a life of its own, growing and evolving in ways we are eager to share with you. To give you a glimpse of what's to come, please check out our newest trailer featuring lots of never-before-seen locations, train travel and story hints through Ava, one of the main characters you will meet in the game!

notes.title: WELCOME TO NIVALIS - MAY 2024 COMMUNITY BLOG
notes.content:
[h3][b]WELCOME TO NIVALIS - MAY 2024 COMMUNITY BLOG[/b][/h3]

Hi everyone. Welcome to our May community blog, designed to give you a glimpse into what’s going on behind the scenes at ION LANDS and 505 Games. Today, we’ll be addressing a selection of community questions that have come through, as well as showcasing a few new screens from Nivalis. Let’s get going!

[h3][b]EATING OUT IN NIVALIS[/b][/h3]

Today, we’re treating you to some work in progress meals you can enjoy in Nivalis. Got a favorite? Let us know in the comments. We’d love to hear your thoughts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40604727/7aa24ed9881ef8bcf570257736b13b05e8fb1005.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]NIVALIS AUDIO DESIGN[/b][/h3]

Speaking of work in progress content, if you’re new around here, you may have missed our behind the scenes deep dive into the audio design for Nivalis. 

Last year, as part of Save & Sound 2023, our composer Harry Critchley spoke about his work on Nivalis. Take a look if you haven’t already: 

[previewyoutube=9PKnNoXY2W8;full]Nivalis | Behind The Scenes: Audio Sessions (Save & Sound 2023)[/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]COMMUNITY QUESTIONS[/b][/h3]

Reminder! Got any questions for the team? Leave them here in the comments or message us across any of our social channels and we’ll do our best to cover as many as we can in our next blog. For now though, let’s go through some of the questions we received last month.

[b]How many apartments/houses will be available for rent? Will we be able to customize our home as we wish in a flexible manner?[/b]
In Nivalis you will be able to rent out more than ten apartments and you can decorate them all as you like. One of your apartments can have a classic touch, the other one can be more futuristic. It’s completely up to you how you want to design your home.

[b]Any chance Nivalis will be playable on Steam Deck?[/b]
We are fully aware of the popularity of the Steam Deck and our aim is to make Nivalis playable on it. However, we cannot fully confirm it yet, but we are very optimistic that this should be possible.

[b]Will we see changeable weather in Nivalis?[/b]
Yes, the weather will change in Nivalis. There will be sunny days, but also cloudy and rainy days. For the latter ones, we don’t recommend going out on the sea and rather stay in the city.

notes.title: WELCOME TO NIVALIS - APRIL 2024 COMMUNITY BLOG
notes.content:
[h3][b] WELCOME TO NIVALIS - APRIL 2024 COMMUNITY BLOG[/b][/h3]

Hi everyone! Welcome to our April community blog. Today’s article is going to be relatively short and sweet, but we’re going to go through a number of community questions asked since our last article and showcase some new screenshots from Nivalis. Behind the scenes, development is ongoing and as soon as we have more news to share, we’ll let you know! Let’s get started.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40604727/7081916071f2ade4897a2b35a24ed424b36dc04d.png[/img]

[h3][b]COMMUNITY QUESTIONS ANSWERED[/b][/h3]

Got any questions for the team? Leave them here in the comments or message us across any of our social channels and we’ll do our best to cover as many as we can in our next blog. For now though, let’s go through some of the questions we received last month. 

[b]Will the game be open world?[/b]
Nivalis will provide you with lots of freedom and you can explore the city on your own as you like. Enjoy the skyline of Nivalis from our beautiful Skyhigh Gardens to the Metro Hub or Central Canyon. But every sky has its limit and the same applies to Nivalis. 

The world of Nivalis consists of 19 areas that can be explored freely. These areas are connected via different means of travel, such as train rides, taxi rides or via the boat. Train and taxi rides are essentially cutscenes which play when you unlock/find a new area. Later on you are able to quick-travel to the new area via the map.

All water levels will be explorable with your boat and the boat will stay docked where you left it last.

[b]What can we expect in terms of graphics options?[/b]
It is too early to talk about this, but we will reveal more closer to launch.

[b]Will there be pets that we can keep and take care of?[/b]
This is an interesting idea, and we will discuss it with the team.

[b]Will the game have its own original soundtrack, or will it carry over the same soundtrack as we've had in Cloudpunk?[/b]
Yes, Nivalis will have a very long soundtrack produced exclusively for the game by our in-house composer Harry Critchley. You can take a deep dive behind the scenes into the audio design with Harry here:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9PKnNoXY2W8&t=2s

[b]Is any kind of combat planned for this game?[/b]
No. Nivalis is a slice of life simulation and the focus will be on exploring the city at your own pace, but also to manage your own restaurants. There will be certain dangers and challenges in the game, but you will not overcome them with combat.

notes.title: WELCOME TO NIVALIS - MARCH 2024 COMMUNITY BLOG
notes.content:
[h3][b]WELCOME TO NIVALIS - MARCH 2024 COMMUNITY BLOG[/b][/h3]

Welcome to our first community blog of 2024 and if you’re new around here, welcome to the wonderful world of Nivalis! It’s great to have you here as part of this incredible community. We have such an exciting journey ahead of us and we’re grateful you’re on board! 

Moving forward, once a month, we’re going to take a moment to stop and give you a sneaky peek into what you can expect from our cyberpunk city, as well as addressing some of your burning questions. We have so much to show and tell over the coming months and we can’t wait to share more info with you all. 

Let’s get started with our first community update of the year. 

[h3][b]NIVALIS PHOTO MODE[/b][/h3]

For all the virtual photographers out there, we’re thrilled to give you a glimpse into photo mode for Nivalis. Virtual photography has boomed in popularity over the last few years and in a world like Nivalis, we just had to include it! But what can you expect? 

Virtual photographers will get to enjoy a huge variety of options in Nivalis, typical of those features you’d expect when using a real life camera. Options will include the ability to change focus distance, aperture, focal length, field of view and so much more! In addition, you’ll also get to experiment with a wide range of creative filters and image modification settings. With so many tools at your disposal, you’re going to have a great time capturing the futuristic and vibrant world of Nivalis through your virtual viewfinder. We can’t wait to see your captures! 

Take a look at some WIP screens from in-game below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40604727/06a925c1238186bf5325cb6c91717c038efeffc6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40604727/d6b0fdae414943d620e6b1078c448c12c5d21561.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40604727/e0d6a1c498163bbdbca5d07717292e3799bf3bcb.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]COMMUNITY QUESTIONS, ANSWERED[/b][/h3]

As part of our monthly blogs, we want to take some time to answer some community FAQs.

Got any questions for the team? Leave them here in the comments or message us across any of our social channels and we’ll do our best to cover as many as we can in our next blog. 

[b]What engine does Nivalis use?[/b]
Nivalis uses Unity which was also used for Cloudpunk. However, we’ve made various improvements during the development, so you’ll get to enjoy Nivalis at a much higher level of detail! 

[b]Can I own more than one apartment in Nivalis and if so, can they be customized?[/b]
Yes, you can own multiple apartments in different areas of the city and customize them as you like. Some of them will also have an amazing view over the Nivalis skyline!

[b]Will there be Mac OS support? [/b]
Unfortunately Mac isn’t in our current plans. Our focus is on delivering a strong experience for PC players on Steam. 

[b]Will there be voice acting? Or is it a text game where you need to read?[/b]
Yes, we will have over 100 interactable characters in Nivalis including voice over. Thanks to the voice actors and the mocap session we did last year, Nivalis' residents will feel very realistic. More on this in the near future! 

[b]Will there be a demo for Nivalis before release?[/b]
We have not made a final decision on a demo yet. 

[b]Will there be mod support? [/b]
Right now, there are no plans to bring mod support to Nivalis. 

[b]Can I wishlist Nivalis?[/b]
Yes you can! More info can be found here:
Steam: https://505.games/NivalisSteam  

[h3][b]THANK YOU[/b][/h3]

Let’s wrap up today’s community blog by saying a huge thank you to everyone that has supported Nivalis so far. The teams at ION LANDS and 505 Games are continuing to work incredibly hard behind the scenes and we can’t wait to share more info with you, when the time is right. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40604727/b1a2cd7ef5c520f4c7dbc27ef4bb992e15f3c504.png[/img]

notes.title: Behind the Scenes on Nivalis
notes.content:
Hey everyone, my name is James, Brand Community Manager at 505 Games and working with the team at ION LANDS on [b]Nivalis[/b]. 

Recently, [b]Marko, Creative Director[/b] at ION LANDS, took us on a tour behind the scenes of the motion capture production on Nivalis and we wanted to share this with you!  

[previewyoutube=zBPduY-VmyE;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]Nivalis | Behind the Scenes[/i]

In the video we join Marko, alongside the actors [b]Christel Wallois[/b] and [b]Florian Hutter[/b] at Mocaplab in Paris as they record all the animations needed for the characters you will love.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40604727/4f45339ef81fc25a4e589951be093e589d295542.jpg[/img] 
[i]Left to right: Florian Hutter. Christel Wallois [/i]

At the beating heart of Nivalis are the citizens and using Christel and Florian allowed for their stories to be brought to life in the best way possible. From moving around in the city, to talking, fishing, waiting tables and even interacting with food. All these little subtle references make for a believably rich world, one that we think you’ll get lost in. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40604727/90ac1d0b52a0318512358ed0f1ebe377ce147651.jpg[/img]
[i]Christel Wallois interacting with a fishing rod.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40604727/8ba480dc40be02efdba6e16ff5cdfcf6127adf64.jpg[/img]
[i]Left to right: Florian Hutter waving arms in an argumentative way. Christel Wallois is turned to the right and looking disgusted[/i]

As you can see, characters play a vital role in the game, and we cannot wait for you to meet all of them in Nivalis and learn more about their lives. 

We want to thank our friends at the Guerrilla Collective for allowing us to showcase this with the world.  

Stay tuned, as we have ONE MORE THING to share with you.

notes.title: Nivalis is a Cyberpunk Slice-of-life Sim
notes.content:
We're happy to announce the next game we're working on.

[b]Nivalis[/b] is a cyberpunk [b]slice-of-life sim[/b] set in the Cloudpunk universe. Choose how to spend your time each day and discover the wonders and dangers of this cyberpunk voxel city - realistic weather simulation and night-day cycles included. 

[list]
[*]Grow your business.
[*]Manage, furnish and decorate your restaurant or nightclub.
[*]Furnish your apartment or buy a new one.
[*]Learn how to make the perfect dish or cocktail for your customers.
[*]Need a break? Why not go fishing or maybe explore the city.
[*]Grow your own food in greenhouses near the docks.
[*]Meet strangers, friends, customers, maybe lovers?
[/list]

This is Nivalis as you’ve never seen it before. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33897382/f183dd55681be0a61b60a1520b0338feea6397ae.png[/img]
